verdict.rationale: pnpm is itself an official, first-party CLI, documented at pnpm.io/pnpm-cli and extensively across its command docs. Several features suit automated or agent use: a dry-run install that reports changes without writing to disk, `pnpm audit --json` for machine-readable output, automatic frozen-lockfile mode in CI, offline installs, and a self-contained executable that needs no Node.js. Community reports confirm heavy CLI use in CI and in recursive monorepo commands. Missing for 10: machine-readable output documented beyond `audit`, and any explicitly agent- or AI-oriented CLI guidance.
